paths.name: Path of Carnage
paths.description: A mastery path focused on toe-to-toe combat

ability.name: Sharpened Edge
ability.description:
Anytime an attack you make is blocked or parried, you will automatically do 262 damage to your target.
Cannot occur more than once every second.

ability.name: Elixir of Insane Power
ability.description:
A vile brew which drives you into a rage for the next 7 seconds.  All of your attacks will ignore 25% of the victim's armor and increases your run speed by 50% for 7 seconds. If you use any abilities, the movement speed increase will immediately end.
You may only use a single Elixir at a time.

ability.name: Swift Blades
ability.description:
Increases your chance to parry attacks by 10%.  Each time you parry an attack, you will regain 20 Action Points.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

ability.name: Pierce Armor
ability.description: A powerful stab that slices through the target's defenses, dealing 314 damage to your target and ignoring all of their armor.  If the target suffers from an Ailment, then your Weapon Skill will be increased by 150 for 20 seconds.

ability.name: Bleeding Edge
ability.description: Your Armor Penetration is increased by 25% for 3 seconds whenever you use of your Frenzies.

ability.name: On Your Knees!
ability.note:
Frenzy - Requires Blood Lust
Costs 20% fewer action points per Blood Lust spent
ability.description:
You spin around and strike your target with a pair of quick, punishing attacks that knocks them down for 3 seconds, and does damage to your target and all enemies around them reducing their Morale by 125. Inspired, your group gains 125 Morale.
   1 Blood Lust:  92 damage per hit, 25 feet radius.
   2 Blood Lust:  129 damage per hit, 30 feet radius.
   3 Blood Lust:  167 damage per hit, 35 feet radius.
   4 Blood Lust:  204 damage per hit, 40 feet radius.
   5 Blood Lust:  242 damage per hit, 45 feet radius.

ability.name: Dagger Storm
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Vehement Blades
coreAbilities.description: You leap from the shadows, infusing your target's weapons with corrupted blood for 15 seconds. Each time they use a melee ability, the corruption surges through their body, dealing 262 Corporeal damage. Their chance to be critically hit is increased by 10% when they are hit from the rear. Your abilities will cost 50% fewer Action Points for 10 seconds. Builds 2 Blood Lust.

coreAbilities.name: Slice
coreAbilities.description: You strike up to three enemies in front of you within 15 feet for 180 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Ruthless Assault
coreAbilities.note:
Frenzy - Requires Blood Lust
Costs 20% fewer action points per Blood Lust spent
coreAbilities.description:
A relentless string of attacks which repeatedly strikes your target up to 6 times over 3 seconds.
   1 Blood Lust:   1002 damage.
   2 Blood Lust:   1224 damage.
   3 Blood Lust:   1452 damage.
   4 Blood Lust:   1674 damage.
   5 Blood Lust:   1902 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Blade Spin
coreAbilities.note:
Frenzy - Requires Blood Lust
Costs 20% fewer action points per Blood Lust spent
coreAbilities.description:
You spin your daggers, creating a dagger storm dealing damage twice to all enemies within 25 feet based on your Blood Lust. Your chance to critically hit is increased by 10% against enemies below 50% health and by 20% against enemies below 25% health.
   1 Bloodlust: 148 damage per hit.
   2 Bloodlust: 185 damage per hit.
   3 Bloodlust: 223 damage per hit.
   4 Bloodlust: 260 damage per hit.
   5 Bloodlust: 298 damage per hit.

coreAbilities.name: Kiss of Betrayal
coreAbilities.description:
You cover your blades with a toxic concoction. Anytime you hit an enemy there is a 25% chance that your target will take an extra 180 Corporeal damage. The concoction seeps into your enemy, causing them to lose 20 Action Points. Seeing your enemy suffer causes you to gain as many Action Points as they have lost.
You may only have one Kiss active at a time.

You may apply Kisses while Shadow Prowling without dismissing the effect.

paths.name: Path of Suffering
paths.description: A mastery path focused on poisons and weakening effects

ability.name: Septic Blade
ability.description: Envenomed Blade will now also reduce the victim's chance to critically hit by 25%.

ability.name: Elixir of the Cauldron
ability.description:
A potion filled from the legendary Cauldron Of Blood which fills you with power, increasing your chance to disrupt enemy magic by 100% and reduces all magical damage taken by 100% for 7 seconds.
You may only use a single Elixir at a time.

ability.name: Kiss of Doom
ability.description: Your Kisses will now heal you for the damage they deal.

ability.name: Black Lotus Blade
ability.description: A deadly strike which deals 277 damage to your target and infects them with Black Lotus toxin, causing incoming healing for the next 10 seconds to become 50% less effective.

ability.name: Enveloping Shadows
ability.description: While Shadow Prowling, your movement speed is increased by 20% and you regain 160 health every 3 seconds.

ability.name: Witchbrew
ability.note:
Frenzy - Requires Blood Lust
Costs 20% fewer action points per Blood Lust spent
ability.description:
You consume a noxious liquid distilled from blood which fills you with power, causing your next several attacks to each deal an additional 276 Corporeal damage to your target. 
   1 Blood Lust:  Lasts for 2 attacks.
   2 Blood Lust:  Lasts for 3 attacks.
   3 Blood Lust:  Lasts for 4 attacks.
   4 Blood Lust:  Lasts for 5 attacks.
   5 Blood Lust:  Lasts for 6 attacks.

You may consume Witchbrew while Shadow Prowling without dismissing the effect.

ability.name: Fling Poison
ability.description: Deals 1200 damage over 10 seconds to all enemies in front of you, up to 65 feet away, also reducing their Strength, Intelligence, Ballistic Skill and Willpower by 250.

coreAbilities.name: Envenomed Blade
coreAbilities.description: You stab your enemy with a poisoned blade, dealing 138 damage.  The victim becomes wracked with pains, suffering an additional 297 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds.  This effect will stack with itself up to three times.

coreAbilities.name: Kiss of Death
coreAbilities.description:
You cover your blades with a toxic concoction. Anytime you hit an enemy there is a 25% chance that your target will take an extra 180 Corporeal damage. The concoction seeps into your enemy, causing all healing done by them to be reduced to 50% for the next 5 seconds.
You may only have one Kiss active at a time.

You may apply Kisses while Shadow Prowling without dismissing the effect.

coreAbilities.name: Wracking Pains
coreAbilities.description: A brutal attack that deals 1015 Corporeal damage to your target over 21 seconds.  If the target is Ailing, then their Toughness and Weapon Skill will also be reduced by 150 for 21 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Enfeebling Strike
coreAbilities.description: You ambush your target from the shadows and strike with a Crippling attack. Your target will take 112 Corporeal damage every time they move for 15 seconds. Your abilities will cost 50% fewer Action Points for 10 seconds. Builds 2 Blood Lust.

coreAbilities.name: Heart Render Toxin
coreAbilities.description: You quickly strike your target with your toxic dagger for 164 damage and apply an ailment to them, reducing their Wounds by 150 for 15 seconds.

paths.name: Path of Treachery
paths.description: A mastery path focused on surprise attacks and positional combat

ability.name: Swift Movements
ability.description: Reduces Feinted Positioning's cooldown time by 40 seconds. Feinted Positioning now additionally grants 150 Initiative and Weapon Skill.

ability.name: Elixir of Shadows
ability.description:
You throw poison around you and the vapors blind your enemies. You will become invisible to enemies for 3 seconds.
You may only use a single Elixir at a time.

ability.name: Rite of Unmaking
ability.description: Sever Blessing builds another Blood Lust and if you are behind the target, it will deal 25% more damage.

ability.name: Heart Seeker
ability.note:
Target must be facing away from you
Builds 1 Blood Lust
ability.description: A shocking strike which deals 389 damage and knocksdown your target for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Masterful Treachery
ability.description:
After hitting an enemy with Treacherous Assault, Vehement Blades or Enfeebling Strike, you will deal 15% more damage for 10 seconds.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Sacrificial Stab
ability.note:
Target must be facing away from you
Frenzy - Requires Blood Lust
Costs 20% fewer action points per Blood Lust spent
ability.description:
You offer up your target as a sacrifice, stabbing them twice, ignoring all of their armor and snaring them by 40%.
   1 Blood Lust:  157 damage per hit, snare for 2 seconds.
   2 Blood Lust:  201 damage per hit, snare for 4 seconds.
   3 Blood Lust:  246 damage per hit, snare for 6 seconds.
   4 Blood Lust:  288 damage per hit, snare for 8 seconds.
   5 Blood Lust:  332 damage per hit, snare for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Overwhelming Dread
ability.description: All enemies within 25 feet instantly take 1200 damage and lose 125 Action Points, they will regain action points 50% more slowly for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Agonizing Wound
coreAbilities.description: A cruel attack to your target, which deals 239 damage. If you are behind your target, you ignore your target's armor.

coreAbilities.name: Puncture
coreAbilities.note:
Frenzy - Requires Blood Lust
Costs 20% fewer action points per Blood Lust spent
coreAbilities.description:
You quickly stab your target twice, dealing damage based on your Blood Lust.
   1 Blood Lust:  157 damage per hit
   2 Blood Lust:  201 damage per hit
   3 Blood Lust:  246 damage per hit
   4 Blood Lust:  288 damage per hit
   5 Blood Lust:  332 damage per hit

coreAbilities.name: Kiss of Agony
coreAbilities.description:
You cover your blades with a toxic concoction. Anytime you hit an enemy there is a 25% chance that your target will take an extra 180 Corporeal damage. The concoction seeps into your enemy, causing them to have their Initiative reduced by 100 for the next 10 seconds. You capitalize on their momentary weakness, causing your Initiative to be increased for the same amount during this time.
You may only have one Kiss active at a time.

You may apply Kisses while Shadow Prowling without dismissing the effect.

coreAbilities.name: Throat Slitter
coreAbilities.description: A swift slice that silences your target, making them unable to use magic for 4 seconds. You will also deal 277 damage to your target if you attack them from behind.

coreAbilities.name: Treacherous Assault
coreAbilities.description: You leap out at your target in a maddened battle craze, immediately gaining 2 Blood Lust. All enemies within 25 feet will take 262 Corporeal damage every time they use a magical ability for 15 seconds. Your abilities will cost 50% fewer Action Points for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Pick Lock
coreAbilities.description: You bolster yourself for 10 seconds, allowing you to bypass the defenses of an enemy keep's postern door, porting you inside.

coreAbilities.name: Booby Trap
coreAbilities.description: You booby trap a siege ram, causing the ram to deal 98% of the original damage for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Faultfinder
coreAbilities.description: Increases friendly ram damage by 2% for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Throwing Dagger
coreAbilities.description:
A quick dagger throw which deals 80 damage.
Your attack will snare the enemy if used behind your target, reducing their run speed by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Shadow Prowler
coreAbilities.description: You prowl through the shadows, making it less likely that hostile monsters will notice you but draining away 5 action points each second.  This effect will end if you use any abilities or run out of action points.

coreAbilities.name: Enchanting Beauty
coreAbilities.description: Your unearthly Elven beauty Detaunts all enemies within 25 feet, making them hate you less and causing them to deal only 50% damage to you for 15 seconds.  You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Feinted Positioning
coreAbilities.description: Your positional attacks can be used without the positional requirement for 10 seconds. Does not affect morale abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Nerve
coreAbilities.description: A directed strike that inflicts 1200 damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Dark Blessings
coreAbilities.description: Direct heals cast on you will recover 10% more health.

coreAbilities.name: Fleet-Footed
coreAbilities.description: Your swift footwork and quick thinking removes all roots and snares from you.  For the next 10 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you.

coreAbilities.name: Force of Will
coreAbilities.description: You stare down your opponent, draining 200 of their Action Points into yourself, and reducing their Strength by 160 for 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Jagged Edge
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy they will begin to bleed, suffering additional 498 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Limb
coreAbilities.description: A precise Crippling attack that deals 314 damage and disarms your target for 4 seconds, making them unable to use melee or ranged weapons.

coreAbilities.name: Whirling Blades
coreAbilities.description: Your attacks which build Blood Lust will now have a 33% chance to build one additional Blood Lust.

coreAbilities.name: Brute Force
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Confusing Movements
coreAbilities.description: Concentrating on your perceived movements, you will be able to Dodge and Parry all attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Broad Severing
coreAbilities.description: Slice will now hit all targets in front of you within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Alignment of Naggaroth
coreAbilities.description: Spiritual resistance increased by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Relentless Assault
coreAbilities.description: A prolonged fervor that grants 10 Action Points a second to everyone in your group within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Shadow Leap
coreAbilities.note:
You cannot perform this action while rooted
You cannot perform this action while airborne
coreAbilities.description: You pounce forwards towards your target, stabbing them with your daggers to deal 164 damage. Your target's movement speed will be reduced by 40% for 3 seconds. Whenever you enter stealth, the cooldown of Shadow Leap is reset.

coreAbilities.name: Baneful Touch
coreAbilities.description: Any time you attack an enemy from the sides or rear with an action, you will gain 15 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Blessing
coreAbilities.note:
Target must have a Blessing
Builds 1 Blood Lust
coreAbilities.description: You sever one Blessing from your enemy and do 127 damage

coreAbilities.name: Increased Pain
coreAbilities.description: Your critical hits will inflict 50% more damage.

coreAbilities.name: Bathing In Blood
coreAbilities.description: Any time you kill an enemy, you will regain 471 health over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Overpowering Blow
coreAbilities.description: You strike your opponent with surprising force, dealing 1200 damage and knocking them down for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flanking
coreAbilities.description:
All of your attacks deal 15% more damage when you strike an enemy from the sides or rear.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Close Combat
coreAbilities.description: Any time you strike an enemy in melee with a direct attack, you will receive 25% less damage from ranged and magical attacks for 2 seconds. This effect will not guard or detaunt abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Frenzied Mayhem
coreAbilities.description: Increases the damage of your Frenzies by 5% for each Blood Lust point you have.

coreAbilities.name: Dance of Doom
coreAbilities.description: Remove all roots and snares from you. You gain 1 Blood Lust every 1 seconds for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Mark of Hellebron
coreAbilities.description: You have been blessed by Hellebron. Your auto attack speed is increased by 50% for 10 seconds after the successful use of any one of your Frenzies.

coreAbilities.name: Riposte
coreAbilities.description: Each time you parry an enemy's attack, you will strike them back for 239 damage which they can not prevent.

coreAbilities.name: Exotic Venom
coreAbilities.description: Increases the durations of Vehement Blades, Enfeebling Strike, and Treacherous Assault by an additional 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Death Reaper
coreAbilities.description: Increases offensive critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds for all group members within 100 feet.

coreAbilities.name: For the Hag Queen!
coreAbilities.description: Your Frenzies will now have a 10% chance per point spent to knock the enemy down for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Agile Escape
coreAbilities.note:
You cannot perform this action while rooted
You cannot perform this action while airborne
coreAbilities.description: You leap backwards from your target, causing your target to be Staggered for up to 6 seconds, preventing all actions unless they're damaged.

coreAbilities.name: Taste of Blood
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you take damage, there is a 25% chance that you will cause 15% more damage for 10 seconds.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Web of Shadows
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 65 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Swift Pursuit
coreAbilities.description: Fleet-Footed will now also increase your run speed by 25%.

coreAbilities.name: Sacrifices Rewarded
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are critically hit by a direct damage ability, you will become protected by a barrier which will absorb up to 600 damage.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Shadow of Death
coreAbilities.description: With a swift motion of your blades, you carve the symbol of Khaine into your victim's flesh. They cannot be resurrected for the next 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Frenzied Slaughter
coreAbilities.description: All of your abilities will cost 25% fewer action points, cool down 50% faster, and deal 20% more damage for 7 seconds.
